subject: Chemistry
description: Properties + uses of N, P, As, Sb, Bi; ammonia, nitric acid, fertilizers

questions.stem: Approximately what percentage of Earth's atmosphere is NITROGEN gas?
questions.explanation: Atmospheric composition by volume: N₂ ≈ 78.08%, O₂ ≈ 20.95%, Ar ≈ 0.93%, CO₂ ≈ 0.04% (rising). N₂ is INERT at normal temperature (triple bond N≡N is one of strongest in chemistry, ~941 kJ/mol). Distractor 1 = oxygen. Distractor 3 = argon. Distractor 4 = CO₂.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.stem: Atmospheric NITROGEN is converted to ammonia industrially by which process?

options.option_text: Ostwald process for making nitric acid
Contact process for sulphuric acid mainly
Solvay process for soda ash output

questions.explanation: HABER-BOSCH process: N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ (at ~450°C, 200 atm, with iron catalyst). Fritz HABER (Nobel 1918) + Carl BOSCH (Nobel 1931). One of most consequential reactions of 20th c. — fertilizers from this feed ~50% of world population. Distractor 1 = Ostwald (NH₃ → HNO₃). Distractor 3 = Contact (S → SO₃ → H₂SO₄). Distractor 4 = Solvay (Na₂CO₃).

questions.stem: PHOSPHORUS exists in several allotropes. WHITE phosphorus is:

options.option_text: Stable, can be stored in air
Used as graphite electrode in cells
A heavy metal at room temperature

questions.explanation: WHITE PHOSPHORUS (P₄ tetrahedra) — waxy, soft, ignites in air at ~30°C, glows in dark (chemiluminescence — gives the name). Stored under WATER to prevent contact with air. Highly toxic. RED phosphorus — polymeric, stable, used in safety match strikers. BLACK phosphorus — most stable allotrope. Phosphorus is essential for: DNA, ATP, bones (Ca₃(PO₄)₂), fertilizers (DAP — Di-Ammonium Phosphate).

questions.stem: AMMONIA gas turns moist red litmus paper:

options.option_text: Red, no colour change at all
Black, due to a redox reaction

questions.explanation: Ammonia (NH₃) is a BASE (alkaline gas) — turns moist RED litmus BLUE. NH₃ dissolves readily in water → NH₄OH (ammonium hydroxide), pH > 7. Distinct test: pungent smell + blue litmus. NH₃ + HCl → NH₄Cl (white fumes, used to detect). Used in: refrigeration (anhydrous), fertilizers, household cleaners. Phenolphthalein turns PINK (not yellow) in NH₃ solution — distractor 4 wrong.

questions.stem: NITRIC ACID (HNO₃) is industrially produced from ammonia by the:
questions.explanation: OSTWALD process: NH₃ + O₂ (Pt catalyst, 800°C) → NO; 2NO + O₂ → 2NO₂; 4NO₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O → 4HNO₃. Inputs: NH₃ from Haber + O₂ from air. Wilhelm OSTWALD (Nobel 1909). HNO₃ uses: fertilizers (ammonium nitrate), explosives (TNT, dynamite, RDX), metal etching, dyes. Aqua regia = 3 HCl : 1 HNO₃ (dissolves Au, Pt). Brown ring test for nitrate ion.

questions.stem: UREA, the most widely-used nitrogenous fertilizer in India, has the chemical formula:
questions.explanation: UREA — (NH₂)₂CO or CO(NH₂)₂. ~46% nitrogen by mass — HIGHEST among solid nitrogenous fertilizers. India is world's 2nd largest urea producer (~25 MT/year). Made from NH₃ + CO₂. First organic compound synthesised in lab (Wöhler, 1828) — broke 'vital force' theory. Dissolves in soil → ammonium → nitrate (nitrification by bacteria) → uptake by plants. Distractor 1 (NH₄NO₃, 35% N) used in explosives + some fertilizer mixes. Distractor 4 ((NH₄)₂SO₄) ~21% N.

questions.stem: LAUGHING GAS (used in dental anaesthesia) is which oxide of nitrogen?

options.option_text: NO, the brown nitric oxide gas

questions.explanation: N₂O = nitrous oxide = laughing gas. Sweetish smell, mildly anaesthetic + euphoric (giggling at low doses). Discovered by Joseph Priestley (1772). Used in: dentistry, surgery (with O₂), whipped-cream chargers, drag-racing engines (oxidiser boost). N₂O is also a GREENHOUSE GAS (~300× more potent than CO₂; ~6% of global warming). Distractor NO = colourless, oxidises to NO₂. Distractor NO₂ = brown, choking, smog. Distractor N₂O₅ = solid at room T, forms HNO₃ in water.
